g1.label: 1. Most students wear a school ___
g1.why: The sentence describes a white shirt and a tie — features of a school uniform.

g2.label: 2. The ___ is a special jacket
g2.why: A ‘blazer’ is the special jacket worn in school colours.

g3.label: 3. Students go to ___ in the hall
g3.why: ‘Assembly’ is when the head teacher talks to all students in the hall.

g4.label: 4. A ___ shows lessons and times
g4.why: A ‘timetable’ shows which lessons you have and when.

g5.label: 5. Maths is an important ___
g5.why: ‘Subject’ is the word for an area of study like Maths or English.

g6.label: 6. A short ___ at half past ten
g6.why: A ‘break’ is a short pause when students can go outside.

g7.label: 7. Students eat lunch in the ___
g7.why: The ‘canteen’ is where students eat their lunch.

g8.label: 8. Teachers give ___
g8.why: ‘Homework’ is work students finish at home in the evening.

g9.label: 9. The school year has three ___
g9.why: ‘Terms’ are the three parts of the British school year: autumn, spring, summer.

g10.label: 10. Many schools have a ___ system
g10.why: A ‘house’ system puts students into teams that compete in events.

g1.label: 1. How old is Lily?
g1.why: The text says Lily is 12 years old.

g2.label: 2. What must Lily wear on her feet?
g2.why: The text says Lily wears black shoes and trainers are not allowed.

g3.label: 3. What time does school start?
g3.why: The text says school starts at quarter to nine.

g4.label: 4. Lily's favourite subject?
g4.why: The text says Lily's favourite subject is Art.

g5.label: 5. What did Lily eat for lunch?
g5.why: The text says Lily had fish and chips for lunch.

g6.label: 6. What time does school finish?
g6.why: The text says school finishes at three o'clock.

g7.label: 7. What sport did Lily play in PE?
g7.why: The text says Lily played hockey in PE.

g8.correct: Because it is Wednesday and she has no club
accept: Because it is Wednesday and she has no club
g8.label: 8. Why does Lily go straight home?
g8.why: The text says Lily has Drama Club on Tuesdays and Football Club on Thursdays, so on Wednesday she goes straight home.
